description: ArboraFM desktop file manager for Windows with bookmarks, saved sessions, SSH access, and PDF tools.
notes: Needs Windows 10 version 1809 or later plus the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Evergreen Runtime. Settings, bookmarks, and sessions are stored in the Windows user profile, not beside the executable. SSH requires the optional Windows OpenSSH Client. The Reduce PDF Size feature requires Ghostscript. The 0.9.0 executable is not Authenticode-signed. The verified ZIP contains Arbora.exe and README.txt at its root. Scoop uses the official download page to detect newer releases. Removing the Scoop app does not delete those profile settings.
